description: Compute the Singapore stamp duty (SGD) payable on a property lease or tenancy from the rent and lease term. Not for purchases: use `calculate_residential_stamp_duty` for BSD and ABSD.

hasPremium.description: True if the lease carries a lump-sum premium.

monthlyRent.description: Monthly rent under the lease, in SGD.

premiumAmount.description: One-off premium paid on top of the rent, in SGD; only counted when `hasPremium` is true.

name: calculate_rental_stamp_duty

stampDuty.description: Lease stamp duty payable, in SGD.

totalRental.description: Total rent over the lease (incl. premium), in SGD.

title: Rental stamp duty
